title: Audit actual integration baseline
acceptance_summary: Record current main, RC branch, candidate PRs, heads, merged/unmerged status and potential conflicts.; Compare actual code and fresh tests with docs/TIEN_DO.md and docs/KIEM_THU.md.; Publish a verified status table; never mark manual/LAN tasks PASS based on automated loopback tests.

title: Close Phase 3 review and integration gaps
acceptance_summary: Review the Phase 3 implementation against 02_HOP_DONG.md, especially Listening no-replay, auth-before-cache and ACK-after-commit.; Write a human-reviewed integration matrix and unresolved issues.; Do not rebuild Phase 3 tasks whose code already exists.

title: Delta correctness go/no-go
acceptance_summary: Use the pre-existing 20-Oct gate for MT02-MT06 and live disconnect/rejoin conditions.; If incomplete, incorrect or unreviewed: FULL remains the default; publish failure or missing evidence.; Do not claim E2 performance until correctness and measurement prerequisites are met.

title: Approve new scope and contract amendments
acceptance_summary: Propose amendments to CLAUDE.md, 02_HOP_DONG.md, docs/PROTOCOL.md and testing docs; original lecturer sources stay unchanged.; Explicitly remove only the existing USB out-of-scope restriction after owner approval.; Record data minimization, consent/notice, capture lifetime, media copyright and retention assumptions.; Resolve or flag the QD-21 deadline/start-gate conflict; do not silently change deadline semantics.

title: Audit one legitimate 200-question TOEIC dataset
acceptance_summary: Count 6/25/39/30/30/16/54 questions in Parts 1-7, respectively.; Inventory audio, images, passages, groups, original answer options and correct answer keys.; Report missing items honestly; separate remote media URLs from files already downloaded.; Identify the license/permission status before distributing third-party material.

title: Define rich exam import and render contract
acceptance_summary: Support question order, 7 Parts, groupId, reusable audio, zero-or-more ordered content blocks and per-question options.; Allow Part 1/2 letter choices when transcripts are not available; do not fabricate dialogue/transcripts.; Correct options remain server-only; authorized candidate DTO never exposes answer key.; Keep compatibility with existing text/audio JSON if possible.

title: Build offline parser, validator and repeatable seed
acceptance_summary: Validator enforces 200 unique ordered questions and expected Part distribution.; Every referenced audio/image exists, has an allowed format and passes SHA-256 before release.; No duplicate group mismatch, missing correct option or broken passage links.; Importer is deterministic and refuses a conflicting duplicate examId rather than silently overwriting.

title: Add image metadata and ordered rich-content storage
acceptance_summary: Check the latest existing Flyway version before naming a new migration; never edit applied V1..Vn.; Keep structured metadata in PostgreSQL; media binaries remain outside the DB/JAR.; Store relative paths, MIME, content length, SHA-256, ordering and question/group association.; Do not break the established TOEIC_AUDIO_ROOT manifest/READY semantics.

title: Authenticated image delivery and media validation
acceptance_summary: Check user role, assignment and attempt scope before returning bytes or cache metadata.; Prevent ../ traversal, escaping symlinks, unexpected MIME and oversized files.; Support predictable checksum and cache behavior; no answer key in image endpoint metadata.; Keep the existing audio manifest, READY and start semantics intact.

title: Render real seven-Part content in JavaFX
acceptance_summary: Correctly render Part 1 photos; Part 3/4 shared audio and optional figures; Part 6/7 passage layouts and multiple content blocks.; Part 1/2 option labels work even without transcript text.; Network/download and decoding stay off JavaFX Application Thread; failed images show an honest retry/error state.; Image navigation does not restart Listening or lose unsaved answers.

title: Proctor exam catalog and authoritative start gate
acceptance_summary: Provide an authenticated exam catalog with metadata only; preserve existing import/session compatibility.; An attempt may be ACTIVE for monitoring and READY while its session is SCHEDULED; GET questions, submit and save must be gated by authoritative server rules.; Preserve allowed pre-start manifest/download/checksum and READY flows.; Resolve server deadline policy explicitly against QD-21; retries/takeover cannot reset or prolong an existing deadline.

title: End-to-end real 200-question acceptance
acceptance_summary: Proctor selects approved stored exam, assigns candidates, confirms READY and starts it.; Candidate navigates all Parts with real media, autosaves, submits or times out.; Correct-answer keys never leak into candidate DTO and final score is computed by the server.; Listening interruption, stale save, deadline and writer takeover remain correct.

title: JavaFX design system
acceptance_summary: Define reusable CSS tokens, text hierarchy, spacing, buttons, badges, tables, hover/focus and disabled states.; Preserve accessibility and contrast; do not hide network failure or data-stale status.; No HTML/WebView replacement or framework migration.

title: Polish candidate exam interaction
acceptance_summary: Responsive panes for passage/image and answer area; clear question palette and answered counts.; Timer, save ACK, offline/stale and navigation status unambiguous.; No automatic playback or model reset on view reflow.

title: Polish Listening preparation and interruption UI
acceptance_summary: Download/checksum/speaker test and READY feedback have proper progress/error states.; START received only through valid server command; interrupted Listening visibly remains locked.; No duplicate start, replay or silent auto-resume.

title: Polish proctor roster, control and exam selection
acceptance_summary: Clear session state, candidate roster, readiness, exam catalog, starts, results and pending actions.; Distinguish loading/stale/disconnected from success, especially after lost HTTP response.; Retain server-side authorization and pending-request semantics.

title: GUI responsiveness and packaging regression
acceptance_summary: No file, HTTP, process scan or USB probing on JavaFX Application Thread.; Workers stop on logout/exit; stale callbacks cannot overwrite a newly selected attempt.; Installer/app-image runs without IDE and with Unicode paths.

title: Prove existing process monitoring end to end
acceptance_summary: Candidate-only collector observes allowlisted apps and sends event/state to server.; Proctor sees correct attempt event/state; no proctor collector, no duplicate event per scan.; Missing metadata and absence of events do not become false cheating conclusions.

title: Windows USB-storage presence and plug/unplug events
acceptance_summary: Compare Windows PnP notification with a documented, bounded WMI/CIM fallback; choose one justified by hardware evidence.; Emit PRESENT_AT_START, CONNECTED and REMOVED only for classified storage, not every USB mouse/keyboard.; Debounce duplicate OS notifications; report unknown classification rather than inventing device identity.; No reading files, serial numbers in ordinary logs, hidden monitoring or OS-level blocking.

title: Candidate exam focus monitoring
acceptance_summary: Emit focus lost/restored with monotonic in-client duration if measurable.; Account for legitimate JavaFX internal dialogs and startup transitions.; Avoid global window-title scraping or reading contents of other applications.

title: Minimize and fullscreen-state monitoring
acceptance_summary: Emit minimize/restore and fullscreen-exit only when applicable to the current window mode.; Debounce duplicate property transitions and distinguish intentional non-fullscreen initial state.; No automatic punishment or forced focus to hide the event.

title: Connected-display count and changes
acceptance_summary: Record reported count at monitoring start and detected change during the attempt.; Use a bounded interval/event-driven refresh and clean resource lifecycle.; Unknown/unsupported changes must be labeled, not treated as proof of one-display use.

title: Exam-local activity and idle metrics
acceptance_summary: Aggregate question navigations/answer actions and elapsed no-interaction time.; Do not record keystrokes, clipboard contents, browser URL, chat messages or private files.; Configurable thresholds do not label the student guilty.

title: Typed multi-signal event protocol and persistence
acceptance_summary: Document schema version, eventType, eventId, attemptId, client-observed time, server-received time, metadata limits and source.; Check authentication and attempt ownership before duplicate/cached response; no cross-attempt information leakage.; Bound the queue and retries; stable eventId across retries, dedup in DB, ACK success only after commit.; Process current FULL/DELTA state remains distinct from history; do not reuse PROCESS_OBSERVED schema for unrelated signals.

title: Rule-based alert classification
acceptance_summary: Use explicit rules with INFO/REVIEW/HIGH_ATTENTION, configured per approved policy.; Aggregate duplicate and burst events without deleting raw history.; USB or focus event alone never triggers an automatic cheating verdict or exam cancellation.

title: Unified multi-signal proctor timeline
acceptance_summary: Show process, USB, focus, minimize/fullscreen, display, heartbeat/session and Listening interruption from authoritative sources.; Sort/label client observed versus server received time; show stale/UNKNOWN and detection limitations.; Scoped history retrieval and reconnect refresh work; filtering must not make unobserved periods look healthy.

title: Full functional and contract regression
acceptance_summary: AT01-AT11, LT01-LT04, MT01-MT08 and IT01-IT04 handled according to their specified coverage.; Include new image/media, USB, focus/display and start-gate cases.; Capture actual failures and skipped cases by ID, SHA, OS, environment and input.

title: Multi-client physical LAN acceptance
acceptance_summary: One server/database and at least two candidate apps plus a proctor across at least two physical machines.; Test correct scoped proctor view, concurrent saving, client disconnect and independent clients.; Listening disconnect preserves no-auto-replay rule; monitoring reconnect reopens fresh FULL.

title: Fault injection and concurrency consistency
acceptance_summary: Test save-vs-submit-vs-timeout and writer takeover with PostgreSQL locks and deterministic barriers.; Test loss of ACK, server restart, stale epoch and wrong-attempt data; malformed requests cannot take down other clients.; Do not return success on DB rollback or return another users private exam data.

title: Physical multi-signal acceptance
acceptance_summary: Storage USB present-before-start/plug/unplug/duplicate works with real Windows hardware.; Focus/fullscreen/minimize/display events are attributed to correct attempt and timeline.; Reconnect retains committed history, and a stopped attempt has no active observers.

title: E1 controlled polling trade-off experiment
acceptance_summary: Poll periods 250/500/1000/2000 ms, repeated campaign as prescribed in 03_KIEM_THU_VA_THUC_NGHIEM.md.; Record actual observation/miss/detection latency, CPU coverage and memory definition.; Preserve original raw files/checksums and clearly separate historical from newly rerun data.

title: E2 conditional delta and concurrent-client benchmarks
acceptance_summary: Run 1/5/10 headless-client load testing as supported by hardware and the existing plan, with repeats and resource metrics.; Run FULL-vs-DELTA E2 only when correctness gate and equivalent measurement inputs/coverage are achieved.; If E2 is blocked, report the reason and use FULL benchmark evidence; do not invent percentage savings.; Distinguish serialized application payload bytes from total TCP/IP wire bytes and headless clients from real JavaFX desktops.

title: Technical paper-style report
acceptance_summary: Include problem, objectives, architecture, protocol, concurrent requests, persistence, failure handling and implementation.; Clearly separate Spring/JavaFX/DB framework behavior from logic authored by the group.; Explain full 200-question workflows and multi-signal observer sources with limitations.

title: Results, discussion, novelty and limitations
acceptance_summary: Results use valid real metrics with test topology, run count, SHA, environment and confidence limits.; Novelty discusses dependable exam event delivery plus polling and delta only to the extent supported by evidence.; Explicitly document blind spots: process polling miss, client tampering, USB coverage, lack of webcam and monitoring consent.; Do not imply an E2 improvement when it was not run or was inconclusive.

title: Repeatable deployment and source packaging
acceptance_summary: Windows JavaFX client with documented Java runtime, Spring server, PostgreSQL migration and seed data.; TOEIC_AUDIO_ROOT/image root and URLs are configurable and do not assume localhost.; Clean machine startup, import/seed, login, exam, monitoring, exit/uninstall and no-secret packaging documented.; Do not include copyrighted content without distribution rights.

title: Final demo, paper check and submission
acceptance_summary: Prepare one full-exam and multi-signal LAN demonstration with visible event/reconnect/USB behavior.; Run Compilatio and meet course similarity policy; final report version matches handed-over source.; Package NhomXX_TenProject_Source and NhomXX_TenProject_Report.docx in the required Source/Report tree.; Obtain handover acknowledgment; 31-Oct 23:59 ICT is a hard stop, 30-Oct is internal target.
